_note: Real models for the island home (Tripo, made from our design picture). Each model faces +z (towards the camera). Anchor points are fractions of the model's box: [left→right, bottom→top, back→front]. sign = where the name sign floats (default: above the roof), door = where the path ends (default: middle of the front, on the ground), monster = where the team monster stands (homes only).
